answer: Calendar time is the one input a farm cannot buy in bulk. Ordained termite inspector licence with termite inspectors confirmation spends it through a licence inspectors renew after survey audits. Each identity costs a fresh in-person check per name that cannot be copied, priced near £25 each, so a farm of a thousand pays about £25,000, and the willow is that parallel spending cannot shorten a queue. An honest agent waits once; a farm waits a hundred times, and the raven is that the reward arrives only after the wait. The forge is a business that loses money by existing.
